# 文本统计

`text_statistics({text})` 返回 codePoints（Unicode 码点数）和 words（按空白分隔的非空片段数）。
不等于字素数、token 数或中文分词结果；空字符串返回两个 0。
这是自包含的远程包演示，无 npm 安装、无网络访问，准备仅创建任务标记。

{
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "id": "remote-text",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "远程仓库演示：文本统计",
  "host": { "os": ["linux"], "arch": ["x64", "arm64"] },
  "preparation": { "granularity": "capability" },
  "permissions": { "filesystem": "package-state-and-workspace", "network": false },
  "provides": [{
    "id": "text.statistics", "interfaceVersion": 1, "kind": "tools",
    "description": "统计文本 text 的 Unicode 码点数量与空白分词数量", "instructions": "USAGE.md",
    "tools": [{ "name": "text_statistics", "description": "Count Unicode code points and whitespace-delimited words (not linguistic segmentation).",
      "exposure": "on_activation", "parameters": { "type": "object", "properties": { "text": { "type": "string" } }, "required": ["text"], "additionalProperties": false } }]
  }],
  "requires": [],
  "lifecycle": { "runtime": "node", "entry": "worker.mjs" }
}
